mappings.meaning: Each Service Domain sits in exactly one Business Domain
Every domain applies one generic behaviour pattern (e.g. Fulfil, Track, Analyse)
Every domain manages one class of asset through its lifecycle
Every domain has one control record: the lifecycle state of its pattern applied to its asset
Qualifiers divide the control record into sub-partitions of equivalent operational properties
Control record attributes draw on the Business Object Model; rationalised together in 14.0
Each operation belongs to one group
An operation's action term says what it does to the control record instance; attributes are filtered by action term for input/output
First-order connections: which domains a domain typically exchanges with
A scenario is an illustrative sequence of operation calls between domains (UML sequence diagram)
Archetypal interaction pattern among a set of domains
mappings.disposition: artefact relationship — encoded as an A2 constraint row for provenance (level-relationships.json, enforceable=false: artefacts are never instantiated in a level export)
